chapter: Pictures, Crescent City Jazzers and friends
title: Abbie and Merritt Brunies on the Gulf Coast
summary: Knew the Brunies on the Gulf Coast in the early 1920s; liner notes for their last album.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: He just reminded me of something. Did you know Abby and Merrick on the Gulf Coast?
Did I? Now, you better believe I knew him.
When was that? Oh, in the early 20s when I first moved there.
So they were over there very early.
Yeah, Jules Gallet, the clarinet player in that band, sent me a recording. The last album that they made. I've got it here. Yeah.
I wonder who wrote the notes for that album. Bill Russell and I did. Yeah.
